Income statement and cash flow 4Q = FY (10-K) less nine-month YTD (10-Q): analyst derivation, not a filed quarterly statement. Balance-sheet 4Q columns are the filed 10-K year-end balances. EPS / share counts are not derived.

FY2018-FY2019 were recast in the FY2020 10-K (new 'Other revenues' and 'Other restaurant expenses' lines; revenue and cost both higher, operating income unchanged). FY2016-FY2017 are as originally reported and are not comparable at line level.

Current segments (U.S. / International Operated Markets / International Developmental Licensed Markets & Corporate) available from FY2017 (FY2019 10-K recast). FY2016 exists only under the superseded structure.
Shareholders' equity is a deficit in every period; ROE and debt/equity are not meaningful and are omitted.
FY2016-FY2019 10-K tables show one decimal; FY2018 onward as later recast are whole millions. Tie-outs therefore show +/-1-2 rounding in recent years.

The company does not tabulate Systemwide sales in dollars; the OM row reconstructs it as franchised sales + Company-owned and operated sales (analyst calculation). Cross-check: 2025 SG&A / reconstructed Systemwide sales = 2.2%, equal to the company's own 'about 2.2% of Systemwide sales' statement.

Rows built from MD&A / note prose (advertising, variable rent, franchise-arrangement property, debt fair value, segment franchised %, employees, delivery / drive thru) are company statements rounded as printed; they are not audited tables.
The Outlook & Text KPIs sheet quotes management guidance and targets verbatim. They are forward-looking company statements (SEC filing text), not realised data.

Official-site material and earnings-call transcripts (out of scope); 1Q/2Q 2024 quarterly flows (prior-year comparatives in the 2025 10-Qs); deferred-tax components, effective-tax-rate reconciliation, unrecognised tax benefits, derivative / fair-value tables, option and RSU activity, monthly repurchase table and the 5-year shareholder-return index (financial-reporting detail outside the operating scope of this pass); FY2016-FY2018 old-structure MD&A tables other than those shown in the superseded-structure block; 10-Q MD&A KPI tables.

Locator = line number in the prepared document.md of the cited 10-K (sources/companies/US/MCD-mcdonalds/artifacts/ten_k/MCD-mcdonalds/FY<year>/psp_*/prepared/document.md). Management-stated conditions are preserved in the quoted text.

table: Net restaurant additions contribution to Systemwide sales growth

Changes in Systemwide sales are driven by comparable sales and net restaurant unit expansion. The Company expects net restaurant additions to add approximately 1 percentage point to 2017 Systemwide sales growth (in constant currencies).

The Company expects full-year 2017 selling, general and administrative expenses to decrease about 7-8%, in constant currencies with fluctuations expected between the quarters. This includes incentive-based compensation costs of less than $ 300 million.

Based on current interest and foreign currency exchange rates, the Company expects interest expense for the full-year 2017 to increase about 5-10% compared with 2016 due to higher average debt balances.
The Company expects the effective income tax rate for the full-year 2017 to be in the 31-33% range. Some volatility may result in a quarterly tax rate outside of the annual range.

The Company expects capital expenditures for 2017 to be approximately $ 1.7 billion, about one-third of which will be used to open new restaurants. The Company expects to open about 900 restaurants, including about 500 restaurants in affiliated and developmental licensee markets where the Company generally does not fund any capital expenditures. The Company expects net additions of about 400 restaurants. The remaining two-thirds of capital will be used to reinvest in existing locations, including about 650 reimages
